title: The existence of $k$-convex hypersurface for a class of Hessian curvature equations
summary: This article investigates the existence of closed, star-shaped hypersurfaces for a class of Hessian curvature equations. By combining a priori estimates with the continuity method, we establish the existence and uniqueness of $k$-convex hypersurfaces for both nonhomogeneous and homogeneous Hessian curvature equations, and by establishing a constant rank theorem, we prove that the resulting $k$-convex hypersurfaces are strictly convex.
